description: This file defines a template class RangeType within the Thunder::Core namespace, representing a range with minimum and maximum bounds, including methods for validation, comparison, and range checks.

classes.name: RangeType
classes.description: A template class representing a range with inclusive/exclusive bounds, providing methods for validation, comparison, and range operations.

methods.name: RangeType()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing min and max to default values.

methods.name: RangeType(const TYPE& min, const TYPE& max)
methods.description: Constructor initializing min and max with provided values.

methods.name: IsValid()
methods.description: Checks if the range is valid (min <= max).

methods.name: Range()
methods.description: Returns the size of the range, considering inclusive/exclusive bounds.

methods.name: Minimum()
methods.description: Returns the minimum value of the range.

methods.name: Maximum()
methods.description: Returns the maximum value of the range.

methods.name: InRange(const TYPE& RHS)
methods.description: Checks if a value is within the range, considering inclusive/exclusive bounds.
